description: Planning and outcome routes: plan generation, risk and code-sync passes, the plan CRUD surface, task updates, codegen, dispatch (preview and the guardrail gate), outcome polling and stats, Slack notifications, the transcript summary and conflict questions. Roster: each key is in ALL_ENDPOINTS (extension/server.mjs); handlers are extension/routes/planning.mjs (generate-plan, analyze-risks, code-sync, plans, plan, plan/save, plan/delete, plan-task/update, dispatch, generate-code) and extension/routes/router.mjs (summarize, conflict-questions, outcomes/*, notify/slack). Every route here is token-protected. Malformed JSON answers 400 (SCHEMA.md), not declared per route. Model routes answer from the stub CLI in the capture; their 200 bodies are the handler's construction of the parsed model output. Not declared, with reasons: 409 on /kb/dispatch (needs an approved review, and approving one runs the external dispatch); the non-preview 200 of /kb/dispatch (same); 500 on /kb/code-sync, /kb/outcomes/refresh and /kb/outcomes/retry-failed (no offline trigger); 504 on /kb/summarize (3-minute ceiling); 413 (the body limit). Rate limits: /kb/generate-plan, /kb/analyze-risks, /kb/generate-code, /kb/summarize, /kb/conflict-questions share the llm bucket; /kb/dispatch and /kb/notify/slack the dispatch bucket; /kb/outcomes/refresh the outcomePoll bucket; the other routes are not rate-limited.
